title: Chronicle of Bolas: A Familiar Stranger

entities.name: Naiva
entities.description: A young Temur hunter who follows Baishya into the hedron and confronts the disguised Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Baishya
entities.description: A young whisperer who hears Ugin through the hedron and falls into a trance of visions.

entities.name: Yasova Dragonclaw
entities.description: The leader of the party who shows her granddaughters a hidden sanctuary and goes into the hedron to reach Ugin.

entities.name: Tae Jin
entities.description: A young Jeskai ghostfire warrior kept under guard at the overlook.

entities.name: Fec
aliases: Fec, of the line of Abek
entities.description: An orc, foster son of Yasova, who scouts the camp and speaks with the false Mevra.

entities.name: Mattak
entities.description: A hunter who guards Tae Jin.

entities.name: Oiyan
entities.description: A hunter who guards Tae Jin.

entities.name: Rakhan
entities.description: A hunter who guards Tae Jin.

entities.name: Sorya
entities.description: A hunter who guards Tae Jin.

entities.name: Mevra
entities.description: A hunt leader related to Yasova whose shape is stolen by Nicol Bolas; she is almost certainly dead.

entities.name: Gerrak
entities.description: A tribe member whom Yasova says will become First Father if she dies.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon who has conquered half of Dominaria, who disguises himself as a pregnant Mevra, asks Naiva to help destroy Ugin, and admits he killed Ugin before.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: The Spirit Dragon whose bones lie beneath the hedrons and whose memories Baishya and Naiva see; a planeswalker in the vision who confronts Nicol.

entities.name: Arcades Sabboth
entities.description: A dragon who commands an army against Nicol on Jamuraa.

entities.name: Te Ju Ki
entities.description: The human elder who taught Ugin about planes.

entities.name: Merrevia Sal
entities.description: The twin dragons' sister killed by humans.

entities.name: Atarka
entities.description: The Dragonlord who forbids the claw of Temur and hunts whisperers.

entities.name: Kiarka
entities.description: Naiva and Baishya's mother, Yasova's daughter.

entities.name: Qal Sisma
entities.description: The mountain range where Ugin's grave lies.

entities.name: Ugin's grave
entities.description: A canyon where hedrons cover the Spirit Dragon's bones.

entities.name: Hedrons
entities.description: Rock cocoons with ice runes that protect the Spirit Dragon's bones and carry his visions.

entities.name: The hidden sanctuary
entities.description: A warm hidden valley and cavern where whisperers' headpieces and carvings are hidden from Atarka.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: The plane where Ugin arrives in the vision and where the story takes place.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane where the twins were born and where Nicol rules half the world.

entities.name: Jamuraa
entities.description: A continent of Dominaria where armies of Nicol and Arcades fight.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: A plane Ugin visits while planeswalking.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: A plane Ugin visits while planeswalking.

entities.name: Lorwyn
entities.description: A plane Ugin visits while planeswalking.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: A plane Ugin visits while planeswalking.

entities.name: Shandalar
entities.description: A plane Ugin visits while planeswalking.

entities.name: The Multiverse
entities.description: The vast set of worlds Ugin discovers beyond Dominaria.

entities.name: Windfolk
entities.description: Elementals attuned to winds of magic who passed Ugin's vision to Baishya.

entities.name: The Temur
entities.description: Yasova's clan, whose claw symbol is forbidden.

entities.name: Whisperers
entities.description: Temur shamans who can speak mind to mind and are hunted by Atarka.

entities.name: Ojutai
entities.description: A dragon tribe that raids Temur hunting grounds.

entities.name: Kolaghan
entities.description: A dragon tribe that raids Temur hunting grounds.

events.summary: Yasova's party reaches the gateway to Ugin's grave, where hedrons cover the Spirit Dragon's bones, and Yasova calls for the group that camps there.
events.quote: Grandmother calls them hedrons. They protect the Spirit Dragon's bones.

events.summary: Receiving no answer, Yasova sends Fec ahead to the cave and orders others to guard Tae Jin against possible Ojutai trickery.
events.quote: It might be. I want you to guard Tae Jin from attack by any of his Ojutai brethren

events.summary: Yasova leads the twins through a secret tunnel into a warm hidden sanctuary and then a cavern of whisperer headpieces and carvings.
events.quote: They are the garb of a whisperer, as you are meant to be.

events.summary: Yasova tells the girls they must become guardians of the carved memories of the ancestors.
events.quote: It's past time for you girls to become guardians of this knowledge, so you can pass it on after I am gone.

events.summary: Baishya hears the headpieces whisper to her, while Naiva feels excluded.
events.quote: I hear you,

events.summary: From a hidden cleft the group watches Fec speak with a pregnant woman who resembles Mevra and claims an illness killed the camp.
events.quote: An illness ate away their lives and brought them death. I am all that is left.

events.summary: Yasova tells the twins she suspects the speaker is not Mevra, orders them to stay hidden, and says to return to Ayagor after a month if she does not come back.
events.quote: After a month, return to Ayagor and tell Gerrak he is now First Father of the tribe.

events.summary: Baishya, saying Ugin is calling her, slips through a narrow cleft and Naiva follows, resisting a whisper telling her to abandon her twin.
events.quote: No. Death is more complicated than that. If you won't come, I'm going alone.

events.summary: Naiva resists a whispered temptation to abandon Baishya and crawls into the hedron after her.
events.quote: But duty and love rooted her feet.

events.summary: Naiva and Baishya fall into Ugin's memories by touching hands inside the hedron.
events.quote: The magic of the hedrons opened a gate mind to mind.

events.summary: In the vision, Ugin hovers above still waters between planes, realizing he has walked between worlds, then arrives on Tarkir.
events.quote: This must be one of the planes of which Te Ju Ki speaks.

events.summary: In the vision, Ugin shifts back to Dominaria and finds the birth mountain now holds a city and temple with curved horns, which tells him Nicol rules there.
events.quote: He recognizes the shape of the curved horns.

events.summary: In the vision, Ugin travels among many planes, then decides to find Nicol again, having mastered planeswalking.
events.quote: By now, he has mastered planeswalking.

events.summary: In the vision, Ugin appears between the warring armies of Nicol and Arcades on Jamuraa and demands they stop.
events.quote: Nicol! Arcades! You must put a stop to this! It's wrong!

events.summary: Nicol, thinking Ugin dead, blasts him with fire before Ugin convinces him; Nicol leaves his army to take Ugin to his domain.
events.quote: It will be. Come see what I have accomplished. Come, Ugin.

events.summary: In the vision, Ugin confronts Nicol atop the birth mountain about his mind-manipulation and the pointlessness of his conquests.
events.quote: You tried to influence me with that trick of the mind.

events.summary: Ugin reveals he is a planeswalker, and Nicol asks to be taught.
events.quote: I am a Planeswalker now.

events.summary: Ugin cannot explain the spark; Nicol calls him a liar and a coward, and Ugin leaves in fury and grief.
events.quote: You can't tell me, can you?

events.summary: Naiva wakes inside the hedron, and Yasova arrives and says Ugin is not dead but trying to communicate through dreams.
events.quote: It seems Ugin is not dead after all. But not awake either.

events.summary: Yasova crawls into the hedron to reach Ugin through Baishya, after warning Naiva that Mevra and the others are probably dead.
events.quote: She crawled in through the tiny opening, disappearing inside the hedron structure.

events.summary: Naiva sees the false Mevra gliding down the path with feet off the ground and calls her out.
events.quote: You aren't Mevra. You're no kin of mine.

events.summary: The false Mevra turns inside out and reveals herself as a gigantic horned dragon, Nicol Bolas.
events.quote: A dragon unfolded out of the illusion, so magnificent a creature that the memory of Atarka's might seemed paltry in comparison.

events.summary: Bolas says he wants Ugin, admits he killed him once before, and tries to enlist Naiva to destroy him for all eternity.
events.quote: That's what I thought the first time I killed him, but he wasn't dead after all.

relations.quote: They had been born together, pulled from the bloody womb of their dead mother, hand clasped to hand.

relations.note: grandmother; Naiva is daughter of Kiarka, daughter of Yasova
relations.quote: I am Naiva, daughter of Kiarka, daughter of Yasova.
now fostered son to Yasova First Mother

relations.quote: She was related to Grandmother through grandmothers who were sisters

relations.note: Bolas says he killed Ugin the first time, though Ugin was not truly dead
relations.quote: That's what I thought the first time I killed him, but he wasn't dead after all.
I thought we were twins, not rivals!
But always Nicol is there to counter him
They protect the Spirit Dragon's bones.

relations.note: calls Baishya through the hedrons; Baishya is a whisperer who hears him
Atarka forces hiding of whisperers and forbids the claw of Temur
relations.quote: We have hidden them here to save them from Atarka.
